review_evidence: README identifies this as an ongoing Lean formalization of the main theorems of local and global class field theory and the repository for the 2025 Clay Formalizing Class Field Theory summer school.

Source-tree inspection found substantive developments in Tate/cohomological tools, augmentation and splitting modules, nonarchimedean local fields, ramification and inertia, valuation exact sequences, unramified cohomology, continuity, and local class-field-theory infrastructure.

The 108 primary Lean files, including the obsolete/ historical files, were retained because they contain formal definitions/proofs and can supply prior-art evidence; the repository's Lake configuration is already non-primary under the standing generated/build filters.
summary: Retain the complete class-field-theory formal development, including historical formal files; no additional repository-local exclusion is justified.
